objective: Recover author-identified virgin first-exposure records from Merot/Auffray family; no model fitting.
eligible_unit: Exactly one initial cyclic loading block per author specimen.
endpoint: Initial-block failure is event1 at directly recorded cycles to failure. Survival to the first scheduled block stop is event0 right censoring at that first stop.
forbidden: Joining physical builds by matching counts, stress, plot positions, or filenames
metadata_gate: Retain author specimen IDs and source-backed physical production build/batch IDs; distinguish powder batch from physical production batch. No missing metadata imputation.
scope: LPBF316L, axial force/stress-controlled constant amplitude for the initial block; environment/R and surface states explicit. Prior data exposure means retrospective validation, not outcome-blind confirmation.
leakage_gate: Exclude all Merot/Auffray source family from population training, including historical derived/multistep records.
admission: Raw first-exposure outcome table can be quarantined separately if physical build gate remains unverified.
